mitigations.label: per-vault-admin-only
mitigations.description: Caller must equal the vault’s own admin. Scope is bounded to one vault’s deposit-data-manager designation; only the vault admin (set per-vault) is authorized.

mitigations.label: per-vault-manager-only
mitigations.description: Caller must be the per-vault deposit data manager (defaults to vault admin). Affects only the calling vault’s validator registration manifest; cannot impact other vaults’ data.

mitigations.label: one-shot-per-vault
mitigations.description: Callable once per vault during V2→V3 upgrade only; _migrated[msg.sender] flag is set permanently after first call.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets the address allowed to propose redeemable-position Merkle roots (proposeRedeemablePositions). Currently address(0) — redemptions effectively disabled until governance appoints a manager. Acceptance still requires the owner (2/2 Safe).

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Proposes a new Merkle root; takes effect only after the owner (2/2 Safe) calls acceptRedeemablePositions. Until acceptance, the pending root is non-binding state.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Activates the pending redeemable-positions Merkle root. Subsequent redeemers can then redeem osETH against positions covered by the root. Worst case: a malicious root could allow targeted users to redeem against under-collateralized positions, but each redemption still settles 1:1 between osETH and underlying ETH from a covered vault.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Discards the pending Merkle root proposal; no live state change.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Clears the active redeemable-positions root; disables future redemptions until a new root is accepted. Does not extract funds.

mitigations.label: init-guarded
mitigations.description: One-shot initializer; KeeperOracles initialization can only run once.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Adjusts the validator attestation threshold. Lowering it to 1 would allow a single oracle to collateralize fraudulent vaults on the next approveValidators call; existing collateralized vaults unaffected.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Adjusts the rewards attestation threshold. Lowering it lets fewer oracles update rewardsRoot/avgRewardPerSecond on the next round (rewardsDelay=12h between rounds bounds frequency).

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Adds an oracle to the m-of-n attestation set. Past rewards roots and validator approvals are immutable; new attestations require the updated set. Threshold (rewardsMinOracles/validatorsMinOracles, currently 6 of 11) bounds the impact of any single added oracle.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Removes an oracle from the attestation set; impacts only future attestations. Existing rewardsRoot and previously-collateralized vaults remain valid.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Updates the oracles IPFS config hash (off-chain coordination metadata). Pure event emission — no on-chain state changes affecting funds.

mitigations.label: oracle-threshold-gated
mitigations.description: Requires a 6-of-11 oracle signature attestation per validator approval. Callable only by a vault that is itself registered in VaultsRegistry. Collateralizes the calling vault; cannot drain existing positions.

mitigations.label: oracle-threshold-gated
mitigations.description: Requires 6-of-11 oracle signatures. Updates rewardsRoot and avgRewardPerSecond globally. Bounded by rewardsDelay (12h) between rounds. A malicious quorum can inflate rewards but avgRewardPerSecond is capped by _maxAvgRewardPerSecond (immutable).

mitigations.label: oracle-threshold-gated
mitigations.description: Updates the IPFS hash of validator exit signatures for a vault. Off-chain coordination data only; no fund impact on-chain.

mitigations.label: disabled-by-state
mitigations.description: Owner has been set to address(0) — Ownable functions are uncallable. Discovery confirms owner=ZERO.

mitigations.label: disabled-by-state
mitigations.description: No pending owner exists; pendingOwner=ZERO.

mitigations.label: disabled-by-state
mitigations.description: Owner is already address(0); no-op call.

mitigations.label: disabled-by-state
mitigations.description: Owner is address(0); the controllers set is now frozen at OsTokenVaultController (immutable) plus OsTokenFlashLoans (only registered controller).

mitigations.label: controllers-only
mitigations.description: Callable only by the immutable _vaultController (OsTokenVaultController) or addresses in controllers[] (currently only OsTokenFlashLoans). New controllers cannot be added (owner=ZERO).

mitigations.label: controllers-only
mitigations.description: Same access set as mint. Burns are part of normal redemption/exit flow; not an extraction primitive.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets the address authorized to call OsTokenVaultController-routed redemption flows. A malicious redeemer can drain at the rate of the redemption mechanism, but each redemption still requires posting osETH 1:1 against ETH. Currently set to the DAO Safe itself.

mitigations.label: position-economics
mitigations.description: Adjusts ltvPercent / liqThresholdPercent / liqBonusPercent globally or per-vault. Lowering liqThresholdPercent can make existing osETH-borrow positions immediately liquidatable; raising liqBonusPercent inflates liquidator profits. Affects live positions across all vaults. Bounded by code-level _maxPercent guard preventing >100% values.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets the max osETH that can be minted protocol-wide. Capacity is checked only on mintShares; existing minted osETH unaffected. Lowering capacity below current totalAssets simply blocks future mints.

mitigations.label: future-fee-only
mitigations.description: Sets the recipient of protocol fees. Fees are accrued continuously via cumulativeFeePerShare; treasury collects on the next state update. Currently the DAO Safe. Bound: future fee accruals only, capped by feePercent (5% of staking rewards).

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets the protocol fee taken on osETH minted by vaults. Applies to future fee accruals only; existing share/asset balances unchanged. Bounded by the on-chain validation feePercent <= MAX_FEE_PERCENT.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Replaces the Keeper authorized to call setAvgRewardPerSecond. Affects future reward-rate updates; existing osETH supply unchanged. Currently set to Keeper (0x6B58...).

mitigations.label: keeper-only
mitigations.description: Caller must be the Keeper; the Keeper itself can only invoke this via updateRewards which is 6-of-11 oracle-signed. avgRewardPerSecond is a forward-only rate used to project osETH minting capacity, not to mint shares retroactively.

mitigations.label: vault-only
mitigations.description: Callable only by addresses registered as both vaults[] AND running an approved vaultImpls[] implementation in VaultsRegistry. Mints osETH against the calling vault’s collateral; the vault must hold backing ETH to remain solvent.

mitigations.label: vault-only
mitigations.description: Callable only by registered vaults. Burns osETH on behalf of a user closing their position; part of normal exit flow.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Marks an address as a recognized vault; downstream callers (OsTokenVaultController.mintShares, SharedMevEscrow.harvest, Keeper.approveValidators) gate on this membership. Adding a malicious vault enables it to mint osETH against fake assets. Bound: the malicious vault must still pass each call site’s additional checks (vaultImpls in mintShares, etc.).

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Adds an approved vault implementation; required for new mintShares calls (OsTokenVaultController checks vaultImpls). Existing vaults and minted osETH unaffected; only enables future minting from new vault types.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Removes an implementation from the approved set. Existing vault instances continue to operate (only mintShares is gated); only blocks future mints from that implementation type.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Grants a factory the ability to register new vaults via addVault. Existing vaults unaffected; only enables future vault registrations.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Revokes a factory’s permission to register new vaults. Existing vaults remain registered.

mitigations.label: init-guarded
mitigations.description: One-shot initializer; reverts after first call (initialized flag set).

mitigations.label: reinitializer
mitigations.description: Versioned reinitializer guard — callable once per version on each clone.

mitigations.label: mistakenly-sent-only
mitigations.description: Sweeps tokens accidentally sent to the vault that are NOT the vault’s own underlying (ETH). The vault’s ETH balance is custody-protected by the lack of any direct-ETH sweep in this function.

mitigations.label: per-vault-manager-only
mitigations.description: Requires a signature from the vault’s validatorsManager AND that the encoded validator deposits pass merkle/proof checks. Calls deposit() on the Ethereum DepositContract for each validator — funds at risk are bounded by the vault’s availableAssets (uninvested + ready-to-stake).

mitigations.label: per-vault-manager-only
mitigations.description: Same access as fundValidators. Triggers validator exits to a manager-controlled address. Eligible withdrawal amounts are gated by the Ethereum beacon chain’s withdrawal queue.

mitigations.label: per-vault
mitigations.description: Per-vault role: sets who can sign validator deposit signatures. A compromised validatorsManager can fundValidators with attacker-controlled deposit data, exposing the vault’s pending-deposits balance. Scope bounded to a single vault.

mitigations.label: future-fee-only
mitigations.description: Per-vault future fee recipient change. Already-accrued shares remain with prior recipient until next state update; affects only future fee accruals within the calling vault.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Per-vault fee rate change applied to future staking rewards. Bounded by the protocol-wide _maxFeePercent require.

mitigations.label: metadata-only
mitigations.description: Pure event emission — updates an IPFS hash for off-chain metadata; no on-chain state changes affecting funds.

mitigations.label: per-vault
mitigations.description: Per-vault admin transfer; scope is bounded to a single vault’s capital. The protocol-wide TVS aggregate is split across many independently-administered vaults.

mitigations.label: per-vault-admin
mitigations.description: UUPS upgrade gated by _checkAdmin. New implementation must be registered in VaultsRegistry.vaultImpls AND match vaultId() AND increment version() by 1 — a malicious vault admin can only upgrade to a governance-approved impl. Bound: vault admin alone cannot deploy arbitrary code; they can only switch among vaultImpls.

mitigations.label: system-only
mitigations.description: Callable only by the vault’s mevEscrow contract; sweep of MEV rewards into the vault for distribution. Cannot be invoked adversarially.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets a per-tx guard checked on each module execution. Affects future executions only; cannot retroactively block already-executed proposals.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Re-targets the Safe that this module executes against. Future Reality.eth-resolved proposals would execute against the new avatar.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Re-targets the address that module-executed transactions act on.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Adjusts the Reality.eth answer dispute window. Lowering it shortens the time to challenge a malicious answer; applies only to future questions.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Time between a Reality.eth answer becoming final and the module executing it. Lowering it tightens the execution window for new proposals.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Window after which a finalized answer can no longer be executed; reset only affects future proposals.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets the Reality.eth arbitrator for new questions; existing questions retain their original arbitrator.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Minimum bond required to answer new questions. Affects future proposals only.

mitigations.label: future-only
mitigations.description: Sets the Reality.eth question template id used by future proposals.

mitigations.label: init-guarded
mitigations.description: Initializer modifier; one-shot setup.

mitigations.label: vault-self-only
mitigations.description: Callable only by addresses registered in VaultsRegistry.vaults. Transfers MEV escrow balance to the calling vault — cannot extract to attacker. Total funds at risk in escrow: ~$16k MEV awaiting distribution.
